newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli industrial output up an annualised 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israeli industrial output up an annualised 4 pct.

text.p: Israeli industrial production grew by a preliminary annualised rate of four percent in March-April after a period of virtually no change starting in August 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
The bureau said the number of actual work hours by salaried employees held steady during March-April, following a decline during the August 1996-February 1997 period of an annualised three percent.
It added that figures were seasonally adjusted.
